<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Cabinet infrastructure approvals:</strong> The Union Cabinet approved the ₹4,371 crore VISTAR scheme to modernize the national statistical system and a ₹14,500 crore initiative to develop 92 GWh of grid-scale energy storage capacity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W24</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Critical minerals support:</strong> The Cabinet cleared a ₹2,814 crore Capex support scheme aimed at boosting domestic processing of critical minerals like lithium and nickel to reduce dependency on imports.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W22</a></span></li>
</ul>
